title: An end-to-end differentiable lane-centre graph from camera and radar: the token champion
subtitle: Spurmitte project | 2026-11-18, final report of the finish line (D119) | status: PENDING at the skeleton stage, filled at the build | VAL 873 frames / 22 scenes, TEST untouched
abstract: A lane-centre graph (centre lines, forks, merges and junction connectors) is computed from camera and radar features. The earlier system was made end to end differentiable step by step and reaches topo F1 0.6912 / 0.6948 on VAL (plain lane head 0.6259 / 0.6249) but keeps five hard steps. We replace its junction machinery by one token head: the predicted nodes of the frozen lane head are tokens, a none slot prunes softly and the per-source softmax of the last self-attention layer is the wiring. With the none target weighted 0.25 and a per-class decode (short lane links 0.3, long connector links 0.2, chosen on the TRAIN sample) it reaches 0.6679 / 0.6762 on two fresh seeds, +0.042 / +0.051 over the plain head, in 16.6 - 16.8 ms against 19.7 ms and with 0.127 M parameters on top of the frozen lane head, with none of the five hard steps. It pays plainly: precision 0.68, 24 vertices per 100 m and a junction F1 of 0.25, still below the plain head's 0.27. The numbers above are stage 1. A second stage trains the node head of the lane head together with the token head (S4): topo F1 0.6682 / 0.6813, S4-HOLDS by its written rule, the champion since D120 (same network, same cost at inference). The past and the map are not in it (both TIE), the pyramid of the lane head stays frozen, VAL has been read by every arm, four output thresholds are tuned, and no TEST number exists.

teaser.caption: One real VAL frame (a T-junction): the plain lane head, the champion (the token head, single-threshold decode) and, for context, the previous system E324 s with rule steps, against the ground truth. Green dots lie within 1 m of the truth, blue is truth that nothing covers. The champion covers the long lane and the crossing arms that the plain head misses (topo F1 0.71 against 0.21) and finds 9 of the 18 maneuvers against 3; this is the frame where it gains most, not a typical one (chapter 6).

pack.readme:
E2E token champion, code package of 2026-11-18 (the report is the separate html file; report + this package are under 2 MB).

code/winners/e365_token_champion/ = the token head (jtoken.py), its trainer, decode and evaluation (with the per-class decode option of E375), the loader, the token cache and their tests, repository-relative paths, MANIFEST.json with sha256 and the source commit. code/winners/e324s_lanegraph/ = the previous end-to-end system (reference). Neither has weights (size limit); both need the repository (they import jtok, jtok_eval, qgraph_eval, qgraph_readout, qtargets, trainer): copy code/winners/<name>/code/ over bev_fusion_lane_center/ and run from there.
code/reporter/ = the documentation system that built the report: reporter.py (build / check / pack), plots.py, winner.py, README.md, SKILL.md. It imports nothing from the project: `python reporter.py build <report folder>`, `check`, `pack`, `selftest`.
utilities/ = the helper scripts the report names.

Run command of the champion (details and numbers in code/winners/e365_token_champion/README.md): train with `bash tools/env/_py14.sh jtoken_train.py --name e373_cb_s<S> --seed S --ident e292_a --none-weight 0.25 --steps 12000 --bs 8 --lr 1e-3 --workers 4`, read out with `jtoken_eval.py dump --run e373_cb_s<S> --seed S` and `jtoken_eval.py score --run e373_cb_s<S> --seed S --link-thr 0.2 --keep-thr 0.6 --no-none-gate`.
The weights stay in the repository run folders (runs/e373_cb_s0 / s1, the frozen lane head runs/e292_a_s0 / s1), not in git.
Status: stage S1 with the lane head frozen (S2 past measured: TIE, no past block; S3 map measured: TIE, no map block; S4 joint fine-tune PENDING); no TEST number.
